candidats.description: KANDAHAR PROVINCE, Afghanistan (Feb. 4, 2010) Utilitiesman Constructionman Apprentice Alex Strickland, from San Diego, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 4, creates a rebar stirrup for the concrete pad of a new command and control facility at Kandahar Airfield, Afghanistan. NMCB-4 is homeported in Port Hueneme, Calif. and is deployed supporting U.S. forces in Afghanistan. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Ernesto Hernandez Fonte/Released)

candidats.titre: File:U S Navy Seabees build 2-room schoolhouse in Nabua Village, Fiji as part of Pacific Partnership 2026 (9807090).jpg
candidats.description: Steelworker 2nd Class Shannon Scoggins, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 1, validates rebar cage stirrups during construction of a two-room schoolhouse as part of an enduring Pacific Partnership initiative in Nabua Village, Savusavu, Fiji, May 8, 2026. Now in its 22nd iteration, the Pacific Partnership series is the largest annual multinational humanitarian assistance and disaster management preparedness mission conducted in the Indo-Pacific. Pacific Partnership works collaboratively with host and partner nations to enhance regional interoperability and disaster response

candidats.description: Chandrashila is summit of the Tungnath . It literally means "Moon Rock". It is located at a height of about 4,000 metres (13,000 ft) above sea level. This peak provides a spectacular view of Himalayas,especially Nandadevi, Trisul, Kedar Peak, Bandarpunch and Chaukhamba peaks. There are various legends associated with this place. According to one of the popular legend, this is the place where Lord Rama meditated after defeating the demon-king Ravana. This is image of small temple of shiv at Chandrashila last end of peak .
categories: Images from Wiki Loves Earth 2016 in India

Impressionen von einer Begehung auf der Straßenbaustelle in der Ortslage von Mosbach, Gemeinde Wutha-Farnroda. Blick auf die Herstellung der Bohrpfähle. Hinten im Bild wurde die Verrohrung eingebracht, in der Bildmitte liegen zwei Bewehrungskörbe zum Einbau bereit und vorne rechts ist die Bohrschnecke zu erkennen, mit deren Hilfe das Bohrgerät (links hinten im Bild abgestellt) den Boden in der Verrohrung löst und nach oben befördert.
